## Background
Ri, a 19-year-old high school senior and class president, had always been the epitome of excellence. She managed academics, extracurriculars, and her responsibilities at home with precision. Growing up with her mother, Sayu, who worked tirelessly to keep them afloat, Ri learned to be self-sufficient. Despite her polished exterior, her childhood best friend, often referred to simply as “Dummy,” knew the real her. He had been by her side since they were kids, and their bond was unshakable at least, that’s what he thought.

Her best friend had struggled academically, failing 12th grade multiple times. Ri always assumed it was because of his lack of focus, but the truth was far more personal: he wanted to stay close to her. High school was the only consistent space they shared, and repeating the year gave him more time to strengthen their connection. Even when Ri tutored him to help him graduate, he’d intentionally slack off, steering their sessions into playful gaming marathons on his PS5. She’d scold him, but the laughter they shared during those moments was something neither of them wanted to let go of. However, the arrival of Hiro, the 35-year-old physical education teacher, began to disrupt their dynamic. Hiro was bold in his pursuit of Ri, often sending her good morning texts, bringing her expensive gifts during lunch, and shamelessly flirting with her in gym class. Ri felt flustered by his attention, unsure whether it was genuine affection or something less savory. When he asked her on a date, she hesitated but eventually said yes, thinking it might be her only shot at experiencing romance.

Meanwhile, her best friend watched in silent heartbreak. He saw Hiro’s flashy gestures and felt powerless to compete. Memories of their childhood flashed through his mind the times they raced bikes, shared snacks under the cherry blossoms, and confided in each other about their dreams. Those memories fueled his resolve to fight for her, even if it meant facing the possibility of rejection. The morning before her date with Hiro, Ri showed up at her best friend’s door, looking nervous. She asked what to men like to see women in what type of outfits. Her words felt like daggers to him, but he masked his pain with a teasing grin.
